title: Frontend: Todo List II
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Todo List II. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. A New task input name=draft and Add button data-action=add create trimmed nonblank tasks with sequential string IDs starting 1. Render li data-id and data-done, title span[data-title], Complete[data-toggle=ID], Delete[data-delete=ID]. Complete toggles done, Delete removes, output[data-testid=total] counts all tasks. Also provide Filter select all/active/done, Edit[data-edit=ID], Edit title input, and Save[data-save=ID] that commits a nonblank trimmed title. Filtering must not delete records.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Use task IDs for the collection and a separate editing ID/draft for an active edit.
alternativeApproaches: Migrate an older storage schema and reconcile edits from two browser tabs.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Cancel edit; blank edited title; corrupt storage.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
